# Case of isolated adults

## Load data

```{r}
path_fig <- here::here("fig/DEB_Models")
path_files <- here::here("mod/Y_DEB_IsolatedAdultes")

col_experiment <- c(
  Nord_aurora[1], 
  Nord_aurora[2], 
  Nord_aurora[5]
  )

l_Experiments_IsolatedAdults <- c(
  "Bart2019_XP1_1",    
  "Bart2019_XP4_1",
  "Gollot2026_dens_D1"
  )

Adults_alone <- TRUE
OM_diff <- TRUE

df_data_obs <- f_import_data_DEB(l_Experiments_IsolatedAdults, Adults_alone)
```

## Simulations

```{r setpointfullin}

Nb_experiment <- length(l_Experiments_IsolatedAdults)
step_sim <- 0.05
select_times <- seq(0,400, 0.1)

Endpoints_print <- "Weight,
    Reproduction"


l_param_name <- c("Fm", "pAm", "r_pAm_pM", "v", "kapJ", "kapA", "Ehp", "E_coc", "rOM_ClxHorse", "K", "dv", "de", "tau", "Sigma_W")

f_In_Setpoint_full(
  file.path(path_files, "kapJ"), l_Experiments_IsolatedAdults, 
  Adults_alone, OM_diff, 
  l_param_name, step_sim, Endpoints_print
  )

f_In_Setpoint_full(
  file.path(path_files, "kapA"), l_Experiments_IsolatedAdults, 
  Adults_alone, OM_diff, 
  l_param_name, step_sim, Endpoints_print
  )

```

```{bash, eval=F, execute=F}

# Put the tab_setpoint.out from the best model in each folder

for j in $(seq 1 3); do
./mcsim.DEBcali_A DEB_setpoint_full_${j}.in
done

for j in $(seq 1 3); do
./mcsim.DEBcali_J DEB_setpoint_full_${j}.in
done
```

```{r}

file_rds_kapA <- file.path(file.path(path_files, "kapA"), paste0("Sim.Res.Exp.full.rds"))

if (file.exists(file_rds_kapA)) {
  df_pred_full_kapA <- readRDS(file_rds_kapA)
} else {
  df_pred_full_kapA <- f_read_Setpoint_full(file.path(path_files, "kapA"), Nb_experiment, select_times, step_sim)
}

file_rds_kapJ <- file.path(file.path(path_files, "kapJ"), paste0("Sim.Res.Exp.full.rds"))

if (file.exists(file_rds_kapJ)) {
  df_pred_full_kapJ <- readRDS(file_rds_kapJ)
} else {
  df_pred_full_kapJ <- f_read_Setpoint_full(file.path(path_files, "kapJ"), Nb_experiment, select_times, step_sim)
}

# Times where earthworm are first observed as adults
df_time_adult <- data.frame(
  ID_experiment = unique(df_data_obs$ID_experiment),
  Time_adult = c(98, 126, 84)
)

df_data_obs <- df_data_obs |> 
  left_join(df_time_adult) |> 
  mutate(
    Adult = case_when(
      Time >= Time_adult ~ "Yes",
      .default = "No"
    )
  )

df_pred_full_kapJ$kappa <- "J"
df_pred_full_kapA$kappa <- "A"

df_pred_full <- bind_rows(df_pred_full_kapJ, df_pred_full_kapA) |> 
  mutate(kappa = fct_relevel(kappa, c("J", "A")))

df_data_obs_kapJ <- df_data_obs |> mutate(kappa = "J")
df_data_obs_kapA <- df_data_obs |> mutate(kappa = "A")

df_data_obs_full <- bind_rows(df_data_obs_kapJ, df_data_obs_kapA) |> 
  mutate(kappa = fct_relevel(kappa, c("J", "A")))
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Predicted Weight for each experiment.
#| label: fig-predkapW
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8

  alpha_ribbon <- 0.15
  line_width <- 1.1
  point_stroke <- 0.9
  alpha_line <- 0.7
  wrap_nb_col <- 2

pW <- ggplot()+
  
  geom_ribbon(
    data = subset(df_pred_full, Endpt == "Weight"),
    aes(
      x = Time,
      ymax = up,
      ymin = low,
      fill = ID_experiment
    ),
    alpha = alpha_ribbon
  )+
  
  geom_line(
    data = subset(df_pred_full, Endpt == "Weight"),
    aes(
      x = Time,
      y = predict.endpoint,
      color = ID_experiment
    ),
    linewidth = line_width,
    alpha = alpha_line
  )+
  
  geom_point(
    data = df_data_obs_full,    
    aes(  
      x = Time, 
      y = Weight, 
      color = ID_experiment, 
      alpha = Adult
    ),
    stroke = point_stroke
  )+
  
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Experiments",
    values = col_experiment
  )+
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Experiments",
    values = col_experiment
  )+
  scale_alpha_manual(
    name = "Status",
    values = c(0.2, 0.7),
    labels = c("Juvenile", "Adult")
  )+
  
  facet_grid(
    ID_experiment ~ kappa,
    scales = "free",
    labeller = labeller(
    kappa = as_labeller(
      c(
        J = "kappa[J]",
        A = "kappa[A]"
      ),
      default = label_parsed
    )
  )
  )+
  
  labs(
    x = "Time (days)", 
    y = "Weight (g)"
  )+
  
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    strip.text.x = element_text(size=12)
  )

pW
```

```{r savetrajW, include = F}
ggsave(
  filename="Y_IsolatedAdults_trajW.png", 
  plot=pW, 
  width=8, height = 6, 
  path=path_fig
  )
```
